nodes.title: SG-8.4.5 Distinguish loading message from submit success feedback
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet renders the submit success message, the history loading message and the empty history message all with role="status" (ContributionSheet.tsx L153, L154, L159). tests/contributionSuccessFeedback.test.tsx uses findByRole('status') and can match the wrong element. Desired behavior: each status element has its own test id and the success test targets the success element. Expected result: loading, empty and error/Retry unit tests pass against real code. Why: unambiguous, stable assertions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given history is loading, when the sheet renders, then the loading message is found by test id contribution-history-loading and the success element is absent
- Given a successful send, when submitted, then the success message is found by test id contribution-success
- Given the loading, empty and error/Retry unit tests run with mocked client, then they all pass against the real ContributionSheet


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet status elements
- In scope: contributionSuccessFeedback test targeting
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Visual restyling
- Out of scope: New API calls
- Preserve: Existing roles, message texts and ids
- Preserve: Retry behavior


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript + vitest with mocked ../src/api/client
- No backend or mock-data replacement


## Definition of done
- Status elements distinguishable by test id
- Related unit tests pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Keep accessibility roles intact


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Loading and empty history messages carry their own test ids
nodes.body:
The loading message (L154) and the empty history message (L159) are plain role="status" paragraphs. Give each a data-testid so they cannot be confused with the success feedback or each other. Why: stable selectors.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given historyStatus is loading, when rendered, then an element with data-testid contribution-history-loading shows 'Loading your suggestions…'
- Given history loaded with no entries, when rendered, then an element with data-testid contribution-history-empty shows the empty message


## Scope
- In scope: data-testid on loading and empty paragraphs
- Out of scope: Changing message text
- Preserve: role="status" on both


## Technical constraints
- Edit only ContributionSheet.tsx


## Definition of done
- Both test ids present in rendered output


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Submit success feedback is targeted by its own test id in its test
nodes.body:
The success paragraph (L153) shares role="status" with the loading and empty messages, so findByRole('status') in tests/contributionSuccessFeedback.test.tsx is ambiguous. Add data-testid="contribution-success" and make the test target it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a successful send, when submitted, then getByTestId contribution-success has text 'Suggestion sent'
- Given a 429 error or an edit after success, then queryByTestId contribution-success is null


## Scope
- In scope: data-testid on success paragraph
- In scope: success feedback test selectors
- Out of scope: Error alert changes
- Preserve: id contribution-idea-success
- Preserve: role="status"


## Technical constraints
- vitest with mocked submitContribution and listMine


## Definition of done
- Success test no longer queries by role status


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · History error alert and Retry stay identifiable and loading/empty/error tests pass
nodes.body:

- Given listMine rejects, when rendered, then data-testid contribution-history-error shows the error message and a Retry button is present
- Given Retry is clicked, then the loading message reappears and listMine is called again

- In scope: data-testid on error alert
- Out of scope: Retry logic changes
- Preserve: role="alert"
- Preserve: Retry button label and reloadKey behavior


## Technical constraints
- Edit only ContributionSheet.tsx

- Error alert has test id; existing history tests pass

- None
